phases.title: ClickUp exception text and payload log lines
Plain error replies and /reorder error modal

events.notes: Phases sequential (shared files). Kiln viewer test file untouched (#137). No route auth (#79). Final PR closes #142-#145, #141, #95, #83.

items: Added common.clickup._endpoint_for_log: endpoints must match [A-Za-z0-9_/-]{1,256} or log as <invalid>, because new_purchase_request_received builds endpoints from an unauthenticated webhook body
update_task validates the requested task_id; non-dict/None responses raise the same ValueError ('no task ID') instead of TypeError
ClickUp errors raised 'from None' so tracebacks don't carry the chained requests URL/query string
/reorder: non-JSON views.update answer takes the error-log branch and returns 200 empty body (before: raised)
No README/docs change needed for phase 1 (nothing documented the old text)
Duplicated _log_received_event in both slack_reaction_webhook handlers (WARN, style); not moved to common because handler tests patch reaction_processing wholesale
'Network error during ClickUp API request' also labels a 2xx with a non-JSON body (pre-existing label, now pinned by a test)
pm_bot_reminder/lambda_function.py:3 unused requests import (phase 3 touches the file)
